metadata.description: A curated Claude Code plugin marketplace of skills, agents, and hooks that benefit everyone. Vendor-neutral, general-purpose engineering and workflow standards you can install into any repo.

plugins.name: workflow-standards
plugins.description: Standards for how you work — with Claude and with your team. v0.1 ships sycophancy, a critical-thinking-partner mode that makes Claude challenge your reasoning by default instead of agreeing with you.
